'''Bleach''' was a chemical cleaning agent that can be used to destroy genetic evidence and other forensic traces.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of Wraith Squadron, a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, used bleach and other ordinary chemicals to wipe down their cabins aboard the cruise liner ''[[Bastion Princess]]'' in order to eliminate evidence that could reveal their true identities.<ref name="MK" />
